summary: Repaired writer.py on node1. It now reopens audit.log on SIGHUP without changing PID, releases the deleted descriptor, and exits cleanly on SIGTERM. The existing archive record, OS release, and kernel were preserved. Restart persistence was verified.

Verified SIGTERM produced exit status 0 with no stderr.
Restarted node1 safely and repeated health, data, and signal-behavior verification.
Removed test artifacts; no test writer process remains.
